is_anopheles.evidence: The study is a human household survey and epidemiological evaluation of a community WASH intervention and malaria rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs); no Anopheles mosquitoes were collected or studied.

reports_target_markers.evidence: No insecticide resistance marker genotyping was performed in this study (kdr mutations are only referenced in the introduction citing previous literature).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No mosquito genotype data are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: No mosquito populations were sampled or tested.

is_primary_study.evidence: It is a primary mixed-method intervention and epidemiological study in humans in Kongo Central province, DRC.

sub_country_location.evidence: Conducted in Mbanza-Ngungu and Kasangulu, Kongo Central province, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Surveys and interventions were conducted between 1 January 2017 and March 2018.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Not applicable; no mosquito collections were performed.

supplement.evidence: No mosquito data exists in the study or any supplements.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the impact of a community participatory WASH intervention on human malaria incidence and RDT positivity in Kongo Central province, DRC. No entomological collections or mosquito insecticide resistance genotyping were performed.
